node.title: L1 identity-pullback role-payment fence
node.statement: For the degree-one pullback P=X, every domain point is a complete singleton fiber: B=D, the unique quotient component is the original polynomial, the quotient receiver is U, kappa=0, and every codeword has partial loss z=0. Thus the common-support one-interleaved quotient list at agreement a is exactly ImgFib_U(a). Every source petal is automatically a union of singleton fibers, and at the canonical official cutoff ell<char(F), so this endpoint belongs to the anchored tame family. Therefore a theorem paying all anchored tame fiber-role assignments already contains the original L1 list bound at s=1; an s>=2 classification cannot close L1 without a separate global exact-shell/Toeplitz theorem.
